estimator.competing_hypotheses: per edge: pure rotation (incl. no motion) vs non-rotational planar warp (homography) vs general motion with parallax (essential); K-free: homography vs fundamental
may_consume: approved intrinsics (fr3 published / synthetic exact / S1 NOMINAL)
RGB-derived keep masks (W141 person masks; S1 also letterbox)
estimator.module_doc:
W142 (EXPERIMENTAL, opt-in, scratch only): observability-aware background camera ROTATION and motion-state estimation.

Complements -- never replaces -- the frozen W140 COLMAP SfM (``app.experimental_camera_pose``, whose conventions are reused
unchanged).  NOT integrated into Production, FramePose, MotionGraph, the S1 camera calibration, root motion or the Generator.

CONVENTIONS (W140, unchanged)
  * Camera optical frame (OpenCV): +X right, +Y down, +Z forward.  T_WC maps camera-optical to world; R_WC its rotation.
  * Quaternions scalar-last [qx, qy, qz, qw].  Image points use the OpenCV pixel-centre convention.
  * World here = the optical frame of the REFERENCE camera (first frame of the largest connected pair-graph component):
    R_WC(reference) = I.  It is a scene-local, reference-camera-anchored frame, NOT the GT or any metric world.
  * Bearing f = normalise(K^-1 [u, v, 1]).  A pure rotation maps f_j = R_CjCi f_i.  The relative rotation stored per edge
    is M_ij = R_CjCi (OpenCV recoverPose convention x_j = R x_i + t); hence R_WCj = R_WCi M_ij^T.

WHAT THE ESTIMATOR MAY CONSUME: RGB frames, their timestamps, the approved intrinsics and an RGB-derived keep mask.
NEVER: GT poses, GT scale, depth, IMU or oracle masks (except the labelled synthetic oracle diagnostic).

OBSERVABILITY (per frame pair = edge, model selection by Torr's GRIC on the same tentative matches)
  NO_DETECTABLE_MOTION             rotation-only model wins and its angle is below the evidence-based detectability limit
  ROTATION_ONLY_CONSISTENT         rotation-only model wins: rotation OBSERVED; translation NOT resolvable at this span
                                   (it may be zero or merely small relative to scene depth -- never reported as zero)
  TRANSLATION_PRESENT_PLANAR_AMBIGUOUS  a general homography wins but the rotation-only model does not: the warp is not a
                                   pure rotation (translation present) yet direction/structure is ambiguous (planar case)
  TRANSLATION_OBSERVED             the essential-matrix model wins: rotation and translation DIRECTION observed; scale never
  INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE            too few background matches / inliers
Translation MAGNITUDE and camera POSITION are never produced by this estimator (value always null).
estimator.name: W142 background rotation + GRIC observability
never: oracle masks (except labelled synthetic oracle diagnostics)
estimator.routing: after estimation and before GT, frames whose regime window is TRANSLATING are routed to the frozen 6DoF SfM estimate where it registered the frame; other frames get orientation-only state; nothing is discarded
estimator.translation_policy: value always null; status UNRESOLVED_BELOW_PARALLAX_DETECTABILITY (with a p90 residual / f bound), TRANSLATION_DIRECTION_OBSERVED_SCALE_UNOBSERVABLE or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never a measured zero

evaluation.constant_camera_baseline: R_est = I for every frame, evaluated with the same alignment (= GT deviation from its chordal mean) and the same relative pairs (= GT relative rotation angle)
evaluation.coverage: orientation status ESTIMATED / all selected frames; UNSUPPORTED, OTHER_COMPONENT and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE count as not covered; metrics also on the frames common to compared conditions
evaluation.false_translation: edges classified TRANSLATION_OBSERVED or TRANSLATION_PRESENT_PLANAR_AMBIGUOUS when GT translation is exactly zero (A1, A2)
evaluation.historical_sfm: W140/W141 and the new SfM runs are re-evaluated with the same orientation alignment (frozen outputs, new metric only)
evaluation.no_ate: no pseudo-positions are created; ATE is not computed for this estimator
evaluation.orientation_alignment: ONE evaluation-only rotation R_a = chordal argmin sum ||R_a R_est_i - R_gt_i||_F over the condition's valid associated frames; no position-based alignment is used for rotation
evaluation.regime_labels_for_evaluation: GT TRANSLATING if GT centre displacement within +-0.5 s >= 0.05 m; ROTATING if GT rotation range >= 1.0 deg; else NEAR_STATIC
evaluation.relative: consecutive selected frames and ~1 s pairs: angle((R_est_i^T R_est_j)^T (R_gt_i^T R_gt_j)); no alignment

gates.classification: SUPPORTED: synthetic + walking_static + walking_xyz gates pass. NOT_YET_SUPPORTED: walking_static coverage < 0.5 or neither orientation metric beats the constant-camera baseline. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED otherwise. BLOCKED: a prerequisite fails. A3 and S1 are reported, not gated.
gates.synthetic (primary rgbmask): A1 aligned orientation error MAX < 0.5 deg; A2 aligned median < 1.0 deg; A1 and A2 false-translation edge fraction <= 0.05; no numeric translation anywhere; A1 sequence regime NEAR_STATIC, A2 ROTATING; A4 frames 20-69 TRANSLATING fraction >= 0.5; 0 keypoints on excluded pixels
gates.walking_static (primary rgbmask): orientation coverage >= 0.8; aligned median < 3.0 deg; aligned median AND 1 s relative median both below the constant-camera baseline on the same frames; fraction of consecutive relative errors > 2.0 deg <= 0.02
gates.walking_xyz control (primary rgbmask): sequence regime TRANSLATING; NEAR_STATIC frame fraction <= 0.2; no numeric translation; the historical W141 6DoF estimate verified and routed for TRANSLATING frames

gt.access: evaluate stage only, after all W142 estimate.json, SfM estimates and routing files are frozen by SHA-256
gt.real: W141 rule: linear position + SLERP between bracketing GT samples (gap <= 50 ms), W141 duplicate-timestamp removal
gt.synthetic: GT sampled exactly at frame timestamps: exact timestamp match (|dt| < 1e-6 s)

syn_A1.trajectory: exactly stationary camera at the W140 frame-0 pose

syn_A2.trajectory: fixed centre (W140 frame-0); R = R0 Rx(pitch) Ry(yaw) Rz(roll) in optical axes; yaw 12 sin(2pi t/4.0), pitch 5 sin(2pi t/2.3+0.5), roll 4 sin(2pi t/3.1+1.0) deg

syn_A3.trajectory: c = c0 + smoothstep(f/139) [0.04, 0, 0.015] m (4.3 cm total); R = R0 Ry(2 sin(2pi t/4.6) deg)

walking_static.source: W141 preflight input (exact frame selection, fr3 calibration, timestamps)

walking_xyz.source: W141 preflight input (exact frame selection, fr3 calibration, timestamps)

s1.note: keep mask also excludes the black letterbox rows (+4 px)

walking_static.source: W141 frozen RGB person masks (Mask R-CNN COCO_V1, score>=0.5, mask>=0.5, +15 px) and area control

walking_xyz.source: W141 frozen RGB person masks (Mask R-CNN COCO_V1, score>=0.5, mask>=0.5, +15 px) and area control

pre_declaration_disclosures: dev smoke of the W142 estimator on the first 40 W140 clean synthetic frames (dev/smoke_out, no masks): code paths and runtime only (0.23 s per pair); no GT score was computed; no parameter was changed afterwards

the S1 clip was located through the W125 action sidecar (source_record) and one frame was viewed to identify letterbox bars; the letterbox rule (rows whose median-frame max < 16, +4 px) was fixed before any estimate

s1.intrinsics: NONE TRUSTED -> nominal f = width, labelled NOMINAL_UNCALIBRATED
